title: Internal: Credit Card Rewards - Points vs Cash Back Representation
summary: Explains how rewards are represented in the transaction database: all card rewards are stored as “points” due to an incomplete legacy backend migration. For cash back cards (e.g., Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum/Diamond Elite, Crypto-Cash Back, Business Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom), 1 point = $0.01 redeemed as statement credit or a Rho-Bank checking account credit; only the EcoCard earns sustainability points (5 pts per $1 on green purchases, 1 pt per $1 otherwise), redeeming at $0.01 per point.
faqs: Why do my cash back rewards show up as “points” in the transaction database?
